headline: Can you name the 5 branches of the facial nerve?
body:
Temporal: forehead and brow
Zygomatic: closing the eye
Buccal: cheek and lips
Marginal mandibular: lower lip, chin
Cervical: platysma in the neck
source: Sources: Kenhub, Facial nerve; Radiopaedia, Facial nerve branches

headline: Never Let Monkeys Eat Bananas
stat_note: white blood cells, most to least common
body: Neutrophils 40-60%, Lymphocytes 20-40%, Monocytes 2-8%, Eosinophils 1-4%, Basophils 0.5-1% of white blood cells (typical ranges).

headline: How long are all your blood vessels?
stat_note: miles of blood vessels in your body
body: You have billions of them. Most are tiny capillaries, venules and arterioles.
